package consumer

import (
	"context"

	"github.com/progresshans/godj/examples/article/models"
	"github.com/progresshans/godj/orm"
)

type Other struct{}

func IterateWithWrongModel(ctx context.Context, querySet orm.QuerySet[models.Article]) error {
	return querySet.Iterate(ctx, func(Other) error { return nil })
}
